_meta.description: Milky Way structure for the galactic context view: log-periodic spiral arm fits, the Sun's distance from the galactic centre, and the Sun's galactic orbital speed and period. Numeric values are stored as strings preserving the exact digits printed by each source; null means the source prints no value. Full provenance in DATA-SOURCES.md.

spiral_model.definition: R is the galactocentric radius at galactocentric azimuth beta (radians in the formula; degrees in this file), beta defined as 0 toward the Sun and increasing in the direction of Galactic rotation. Pitch angle psi_before applies for beta <= beta_kink, psi_after above it. Galactic rotation is clockwise viewed from the north Galactic pole.
spiral_model.assumed_r0_note: Table 2 note: 'The models assume R0 = 8.15 kpc.'
spiral_model.source: Reid, M. J., et al., 'Trigonometric Parallaxes of High-mass Star-forming Regions: Our View of the Milky Way', The Astrophysical Journal 885, 131 (2019), DOI 10.3847/1538-4357/ab4a11 (arXiv:1910.03357), Sect. 3 and Table 2

_meta.bar_note: The cited paper prints no dimensions for the Galactic bar (its figures show a schematic bar after Wegg, Gerhard & Portail 2015), so the view draws no bar rather than an uncited one.
_meta.kink_uncertainty_note: Table 2 note: a beta_kink printed without uncertainty was not solved for and was assigned a value based primarily on a gap in sources; those entries carry null here.
_meta.tangency_note: Table 2 prints '...' for the Galactic-longitude tangency of the Local, Perseus and Outer arms; those fields are null.

sun.source: GRAVITY Collaboration, 'Mass distribution in the Galactic Center based on interferometric astrometry of multiple stellar orbits', Astronomy & Astrophysics 657, L12 (2022), DOI 10.1051/0004-6361/202142465 (arXiv:2112.07478): 'The best fit further yields R0 = (8277 +/- 9) pc' (statistical error).

rotation.source: NRAO, 'Orbital Period of the Sun in the Milky Way Galaxy?', https://public.nrao.edu/ask/orbital-period-of-the-sun-in-the-milky-way-galaxy/
